posts.title: Washington Skies
posts.description: My tears rain down like Washington skies. I look all around for the gracing of eyes. In the courtyard where there was nowhere to go. A place where only the wanderers grow. Those who push forward despite their own greed; or who sprint through so fast that their spirits are speed. All the while, going it alone. The body and place, the only remanence of home.

posts.title: Life is a Paged Book
posts.description: We are the author and the pen, the paper and the desk. Life has a pattern to it, a shape beyond geometry and a gradient beyond polarity. A shape without size and a size without shape. A weight without volume, a sound without noise. A product without medium, a future without a past. The ground without a sky, and dirt without the Earth.

posts.title: T'z
posts.description: Tortuses and trees, and anything that starts with tees, they were meant to sit to enjoy the breeze. Years of age, bacteriophage, to lie and graze in the sunny days. It pays the wage to phase the mage in the ways of the page when one lays in the cage of the sage. To take a lake and seek a fake, to tempt a fate, to fall and break. To peak for sake of another ache, to rack the rake and leap in lake,
